pages.title: Vireo documentation
pages.description: Learn Vireo through task-oriented guides, framework concepts, working examples and explicit ownership boundaries.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.description: Create a Vireo application, validate the local environment and reach a working development loop.

pages.title: Choose a project profile
pages.description: Choose frontend-only or full-stack according to the ownership boundary your organization already has.

pages.title: Frontend-only applications
pages.description: Run Vireo without Java or a database and connect the React application to a separately owned company API.

pages.title: Full-stack applications
pages.description: Run the complete React and Spring Boot golden path with an embedded or PostgreSQL database.

pages.title: Architecture
pages.description: Understand Vireo's layers, request paths, replaceable seams and application ownership model.

pages.title: Ownership boundaries
pages.description: Separate framework guarantees, replaceable adapters, generated code and application-owned product decisions.

pages.title: Adapters and company APIs
pages.description: Replace mock or HTTP defaults through stable authentication, item, query and history adapter slots.

pages.title: Wire contracts
pages.description: Keep generated frontend transports, schemas and backend DTO boundaries aligned without hiding domain decisions.

pages.title: Generated code ownership
pages.description: Know what Vireo may regenerate, how drift is detected and when to eject a capability into application ownership.

pages.title: Frontend foundations
pages.description: Use Vireo's React libraries for page composition, queries, forms, localization, history and offline-aware UX.

pages.title: Spring Boot foundations
pages.description: Adopt the coordinated Vireo BOM and Spring modules while keeping application domain and authorization policy explicit.

pages.title: Offline behavior
pages.description: Understand the offline shell guarantee, queue boundaries and the domain decisions Vireo deliberately does not infer.

pages.title: Components
pages.description: Find Vireo component families, usage guidance and direct links into the interactive Storybook catalogue.

pages.title: Build a vertical slice
pages.description: Generate, inspect, run and verify one complete Purchase Order capability in a Vireo project.

pages.title: Design system
pages.description: Apply Vireo's stable visual, responsive, interaction and quality contracts while retaining application-owned product decisions.

pages.title: Visual language
pages.description: Compose operational interfaces with semantic surfaces, clear hierarchy, intentional color roles and accessible command surfaces.

pages.title: Responsive shell
pages.description: Preserve tasks, state and accessibility across wide and compact navigation, page and data-view compositions.

pages.title: Motion
pages.description: Use calm, accessible feedback that explains change without depending on animation or adding visual noise.

pages.title: Loading states
pages.description: Preserve context, geometry and accessibility while pages, data, forms and actions perform asynchronous work.

pages.title: Forms and validation
pages.description: Structure models, form modes, validation timing and submission feedback for accessible, reliable workflows.

pages.title: Authentication and errors
pages.description: Normalize session, transport and rendering failures into accessible, contextual recovery experiences.

pages.title: Localization and copy
pages.description: Keep copy, validation, accessible labels and temporal formatting consistent in every supported locale.

pages.title: Quality and release
pages.description: Turn visual, responsive, accessibility and recovery expectations into repeatable release evidence.

pages.title: Vireo CLI
pages.description: Create projects and manage generated capabilities with the two executables published by create-vireo.

pages.title: Doctor diagnostics
pages.description: Diagnose environment, dependency, metadata, port and profile problems without modifying the project.

pages.title: Entity generation
pages.description: Generate reviewable frontend or full-stack capabilities from a versioned entity schema and verify their integrity.

pages.title: Project upgrades
pages.description: Preview supported Vireo-managed migrations, apply them deliberately and retain application-owned changes.

pages.title: Deployment
pages.description: Package and deploy Vireo applications with explicit profiles, health endpoints, secrets and rollback boundaries.

pages.title: Security
pages.description: Understand framework controls, application responsibilities, supported reporting and production-hardening boundaries.

pages.title: Accessibility
pages.description: Apply Vireo's keyboard, focus, responsive and semantic UI expectations to product-specific workflows.

pages.title: Troubleshooting
pages.description: Resolve the most common environment, port, dependency, database, PWA and generated-contract failures.
